#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

DATA_ROOT=/srv/data
SNAP_ROOT=/srv/.data-snapshots

usage() {
  printf 'Usage: %s {create|restore|list} [snapshot-name]\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
  exit 64
}

valid_name() {
  [[ ${1:-} =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]]
}

require_same_xfs() {
  local data_dev snap_dev fs_type
  fs_type=$(findmnt -n -o FSTYPE --target "$DATA_ROOT")
  data_dev=$(findmnt -n -o SOURCE --target "$DATA_ROOT")
  snap_dev=$(findmnt -n -o SOURCE --target "$SNAP_ROOT")
  [[ "$fs_type" == xfs && "$data_dev" == "$snap_dev" ]] || {
    printf 'Data and snapshot store must be on the same XFS filesystem\n' >&2
    exit 1
  }
}

mkdir -p -- "$DATA_ROOT" "$SNAP_ROOT"
chmod 0700 "$SNAP_ROOT"
require_same_xfs

case ${1:-} in
  create)
    name=${2:-}
    valid_name "$name" || usage
    final="$SNAP_ROOT/$name"
    [[ ! -e "$final" ]] || { printf 'Snapshot already exists: %s\n' "$name" >&2; exit 1; }
    stage="$SNAP_ROOT/.staging.$name.$$"
    trap 'rm -rf -- "$stage"' EXIT
    cp -a --reflink=always -- "$DATA_ROOT" "$stage"
    mv -- "$stage" "$final"
    trap - EXIT
    sync -f "$SNAP_ROOT"
    printf 'created %s\n' "$name"
    ;;
  restore)
    name=${2:-}
    valid_name "$name" || usage
    source="$SNAP_ROOT/$name"
    [[ -d "$source" ]] || { printf 'Snapshot not found: %s\n' "$name" >&2; exit 1; }
    stage="/srv/.data.restore.$$"
    old="/srv/.data.previous.$$"
    [[ ! -e "$stage" && ! -e "$old" ]] || { printf 'Restore staging path collision\n' >&2; exit 1; }
    trap 'rm -rf -- "$stage"; if [[ -d "$old" && ! -e "$DATA_ROOT" ]]; then mv -- "$old" "$DATA_ROOT"; fi' EXIT
    cp -a --reflink=always -- "$source" "$stage"
    mv -- "$DATA_ROOT" "$old"
    mv -- "$stage" "$DATA_ROOT"
    sync -f /srv
    rm -rf -- "$old"
    trap - EXIT
    printf 'restored %s\n' "$name"
    ;;
  list)
    find "$SNAP_ROOT" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name '.staging.*' -printf '%f\n' | LC_ALL=C sort
    ;;
  *)
    usage
    ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_DATA_SNAPSHOT_EOF
